about.text: A dried food of cracked wheat or a couscous-like paste mixed with fermented milk, dried into coarse crumbs and made into a thick soup. It is acidic and dry, so it keeps long. In Cyprus it is a national speciality, often served with halloumi.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Cracked wheat or a couscous-like paste mixed with yogurt or sour milk, fermented, then dried to 6–10 % moisture and ground
Eaten at breakfast in rural Albania, cooked with milk into a soup
